segments.text: V. 31. The common Tranſlation is, By chance—Which is full of groſs Improprieties. For if we ſpeak ſtrictly, there is no ſuch Thing in the Univerſe as either Chance or Fortune. A certain prieſt came down that way, and paſſed by on the other ſide—And both he and the Levite, no Doubt, could find an Excuſe for paſſing over on the other Side, and might perhaps gravely thank GOD for their own Deliverance, while they left their Brother bleeding to Death. Is it not an Emblem of many living Characters, perhaps of ſome who bear the ſacred Office? O Houſe of Levi and of Aaron, is not the Day coming, when the Virtues of Heathens and Samaritans will riſe up in the Judgment againſt you?
